name: fit
description: Estate assessment and repo clinic: reads a repository, builds on the sdlc audit and recommends which modules of the suit to fit, in which order and why, with a gate check that every module marked fitted is present; audits a public repository at its owner's request, drafting one short report and one small pull request; and files a review's findings as GitHub Issues labelled by area, kind and severity, with a scorecard per area.
